tei:div.tei:p: /phyag chen chos drug brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rigs bdag ma bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru// rigs rnams kun gyi mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang*// dkyil 'khor ma lus dbang bsgyur bcom ldan 'das// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad 'khor lo mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// bhaṅga la ru thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs// gnyis med bde ba chen po'i rtogs pa shar// zung 'jug mngon gyur rje btsun tilli pa// bde chen gnyis med mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// lus srog phyag dar khrod bzhin dor byas nas// bla ma'i bka' bsgrubs mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// gzhan don mthar phyin mkhas mchog nā ro pa// mdzad pa phul byung mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du byon pa'i tshe// gsang sngags chos rnams ma lus thugs su chud// skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang phyug lho brag pa// ma rig mun sel mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// sgrub brgyud bstan pa 'dzin pa'i mgon gyur cing*// 'gro rnams thar pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad// gangs can rtogs pa mthar phyin mi la rje// gnyis med 'od gsal mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// pha rol phyin pa'i tshul lugs thugs chud cing*// gsang sngags spros med ngang las mi g.yo zhing*// sku lnga yongs rdzogs mnyam med sgam po pa// brgyud pa gsum ldan mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi rnam 'phrul zhes// 'jig rten gsum na nyi zla ltar grags pa'i// man ngag mdzod 'dzin dpal ldan phag gru pa// srid zhi mnyam nyid mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// gdod ma'i gnas lugs zab mo'i 'khor lo dang*// rang byung rang gsal brjod bral dpe 'das par// thams cad mkhyen pa mgon po rin chen dpal// gnyis med ye shes mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// de sras thu bo bsod nams grags pa'i mtshan// gnyis med rdo rje grags dang thog kha ba// grub thob mes chen rgyal tshab kun 'dzin zhing*// mtha' yas yon tan mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// dri med rgyal ba'i dbang po mtshams bcad pa// rdo rje rin chen rdo rje rgyal po'i zhabs// 'gro ba'i ded dpon nyid sprul chos kyi rje// lung rtogs yon tan mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// thub bstan rgyas mdzad chos kyi rgyal po nyid// don grub rgyal po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi// sgrub brgyud bstan pa gsal ba'i sgron me 'dzin// mthu stobs dpag med mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// 'dul ba 'dzin pa ngag gi dbang rgyal mtshan// ngag gi dbang po chos kyi rgyal po yi// mi nub chos sku'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa// phrin las mi zad mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// des gsung dri med bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus shing*// rnam dpyod blo yi bum par legs bzung nas// dad ldan skye med 'god mdzad kun dga'i mtshan// rnam bzhi 'gro don mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// phyag chen chos drug brgyud pa'i bla ma la// mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'di btab pas// bdag sogs 'gro ba lus can ma lus kun// tshe 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa thob gyur cig

/gang yang dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba dri med mtha' yas mnga' ba'i mthus// bka' brgyud bstan pa rin chen rgyas gyur nas// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gnas gyur cig /'di nyid gus pa'i stobs kyis brjod gyur pa'i// gang zag skal ldan de dag thams cad la// brgyud pa'i bla mas rjes su 'dzin pa dang*// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs/// /zhes pa 'di yang ā nanda shrī bha dras sbyar ba'o // //
